title: libcuflynx module config (*_modules_config.json)
description: A list of module config entries: component entries in libcuflynx keys (vessel_type, BC_type, module_file, module_type) or PhLynx keys (module_type, module_subtype, component_file, component_type), and supermodule entries (module_format "supermodule" with a submodules list of instance records). See libcuflynx/utilities/config_schemas.py. Any entry may name a default_parameterisation (older name: default_instance): a directory under parameterisations/ (instances/ in older libraries) next to the config file holding <name>_parameters.csv.

port_type.description: Required. The kind of port; ports connect to ports of the same port_type (e.g. vessel_port, flow_port, pressure_port, volume_port, or any name of your own).

variables.description: Required. The module variables the port maps, in order, onto the same positions of the connected port. An empty string or null maps nothing in that position.

multi_port.description: Whether the port takes several connections, and how (libcuflynx/generators/multi_port.py). "True" (or true): every connected module's variables are mapped to this module's (one source, many sinks). "Sum" (any case): the port's one variable is the sum over every connected module (on a volume_port, the legacy blood-volume sum). "Multiply" (any case): the port's one variable, times multiply_factor, sets each connected module's variable. A list gives one "sum", "True" or "multiply" (any case) per variable. Default (absent, null, false or "False"): one connection.

multiply_factor.description: The factor of the port's Multiply variables (a number, or a string holding one), or a list with one entry per variable: a number for each "multiply" variable, null for the others. Default: 1.

only_one_port.description: On an entrance or general port: when a connection is made through it, no other port pair of the same two modules is connected. Default: false.

port.description: A port: a named group of variables that connect to the matching port of a connected module (by port_type).

allOf.description: multiply_factor needs a "Multiply" multi_port, or a list with a "multiply" entry.

libcuflynxComponent.title: component entry, libcuflynx keys

vessel_type.description: Required. The module type an instance names (libcuflynx vessel_type, PhLynx module_type).

BC_type.description: Required. The version of the module type (libcuflynx BC_type, PhLynx module_subtype). (type, version) is unique across the module configs in use.

module_file.description: Required. The CellML (or C++) file holding the component, relative to this config file's directory.

module_type.description: Required. The component's name in that file.

module_format.description: The format of the module's file: "cellml" (written into the generated CellML model) or another value such as "cpp" (a module the CellML model leaves out). Default: none, treated as not "cellml". "supermodule" is a supermodule entry.

entrance_ports.description: The ports a module listed in an instance's inp list connects to. Default: none.

exit_ports.description: The ports a module listed in an instance's out list connects to. Default: none.

general_ports.description: Ports that connect in either direction. Default: none (null is none).

prefixItems.description: the variable name in the CellML component
"access": the variable is exposed (public) to the generated model; "no_access": it is not

"constant" (a parameter named <variable>_<instance> in the parameters file), "global_constant" (a parameter shared by every instance, named <variable>), "boundary_condition" (a parameter named <variable>_<instance> that a connection can replace), or "variable" (computed by the model, not a parameter)

variables_and_units.description: The component's variables: [name, units, "access" | "no_access", kind] each. The kind decides which parameters the parameters file must set. Default: none.

default_parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (a directory under parameterisations/, or instances/ in older libraries, next to this config file) used when a record names none; ignored if its <name>_parameters.csv does not exist

default_instance.description: the older name of "default_parameterisation" (still read; give one of the two, or both with the same value)

variables_to_delay.description: the variables whose delayed value is needed

delayed_variables.description: the variables that receive them, one per variables_to_delay entry

delay_amounts.description: the delay of each, a number or a parameter name

delay_info.description: model_type cpp only: delayed copies of variables (CVSCppGenerator). Default: none.

libcuflynxComponent.description: A module that lives in a CellML (or C++) file. Other keys (licence, creator, notes, ...) are allowed and not read.

supermodule.title: supermodule entry

vessel_type.description: The supermodule's type (libcuflynx keys). Required with BC_type, unless module_type/module_subtype are given.

module_type.description: The supermodule's type (PhLynx keys). Required with module_subtype, unless vessel_type/BC_type are given.

module_format.description: Must be "supermodule" when given. Default: "supermodule" (a submodules list makes the entry a supermodule).

submodules.description: Required. Module-array records whose names are local to the supermodule. Their inp/out lists name sibling submodules only; each may name its own "parameterisation" ("instance" is refused). Connections to the host model are made by the instance's per_submodule_inputs / per_submodule_outputs.

default_parameters.description: legacy: parameters CSV relative to this config file; rows {var}_{submodule} are local, others global. Prefer parameterisations/<name>/<name>_parameters.csv with default_parameterisation

default_parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (a directory under parameterisations/, or instances/ in older libraries, next to this config file) used when a record names none; ignored if its <name>_parameters.csv does not exist

default_instance.description: the older name of "default_parameterisation" (still read; give one of the two, or both with the same value)

supermodule.description: A named group of modules (submodules) that an instance names like any module; it is expanded into its submodules (<instance>_<submodule>) before the model is built (libcuflynx/utilities/supermodules.py). Recognised by module_format "supermodule" or a submodules list. It has no component of its own. Other keys are allowed and not read.

name.description: A name with no whitespace inside it (surrounding whitespace is stripped): names become CellML component and variable names.

nameList.description: instance names: a list, or one space-separated string (null: none)

perSubmodule.description: {submodule: [host, ...]}, or a list of one-key objects A submodule may appear once (the loader checks this; JSON Schema cannot).

name.description: Required. The instance name, unique in the array; a module's parameters and variables are named <variable>_<name>.

module_type.description: Required. The module type: the vessel_type (PhLynx: module_type) of a module config entry.

module_subtype.description: Required. The module version: the BC_type (PhLynx: module_subtype) of that entry.

inp_instances.description: The instances feeding this one (connected to its entrance ports). Default: none.

out_instances.description: The instances this one feeds (connected to its exit ports). Default: none.

per_submodule_inputs.description: Supermodule instances only: {submodule: [host instance, ...]}, the host instances feeding each submodule. Each host must list this instance in its out list. Default: none.

per_submodule_outputs.description: Supermodule instances only: {submodule: [host instance, ...]}, the host instances each submodule feeds. Each host must list this instance in its inp list. Default: none.

parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (named parameter set of the module version) whose parameters this record uses: <config dir>/parameterisations/<name>/<name>_parameters.csv, or instances/<name>/ in older libraries (default: the config entry's default_parameterisation, if that file exists)

allOf.description: "instance" is not a record key: a record names its parameter set with "parameterisation".
